title: Review and verification
description: Keeps review and verification criteria, observations, evidence and judgments distinct, with explicit applicability, coverage and provenance.
responsibilities: Retain criterion-based verification definitions and actual observations with provenance.
Assess applicability and coverage, including contradictions and reassessment after changes.
Record the scope and basis of an authorized engineering judgment.

Contribute evidence applicability and criterion-coverage analysis through FUNC-029/FUNC-030 to MOD-017's IF-010 contract. Verification definitions, actual observations, and scoped judgments retain their respective owners and recorded provenance; analysis does not execute checks or create judgments.

Prepare assessor-supplied assurance content and scoped reliance diagnostics through MOD-017 IF-014 under assurance-content.md; guided participants explicitly record it through existing command/storage contracts.
owned_state: Verification definitions, evidence records, applicability/coverage assessments, and scoped judgments as engineering content; raw persistence and authority remain separate responsibilities.

includes: Verification and assurance information and assessments.
excludes: Inventing observations from planned tests, treating schema success as satisfaction, or conferring judgment authority.

design_limits: IR-004 AR-062–066 and assurance-content.md define method/observation preparation, applicability, judgments, reassessment, participant-mediated retention and assessor-assisted realization. Actual technique execution remains with the selected assessor/tool; no universal runner or automatic sufficiency engine is introduced.
Neither an Interface response nor its existence establishes verification execution, release qualification, authority, or requirement satisfaction.

The requirement-first workflow design supplies the selected SR-079–083 collaboration and AR allocation. Earlier broader deferrals remain only outside that bounded extension; existing runtime observations and installed contracts do not implement the target design.

sources.basis: Analyst-proposed responsibility boundary derived from the existing Function landscape. Assigned Functions remain authoritative for behavior; this record describes target architecture, not observed implementation.

sources.locator: MOD-007; SCN-019, SCN-053, SCN-066 selected collaboration analysis
sources.basis: Derive consumer-focused parent contracts for selected-state inspection, adopted-REM authoring guidance, applicable action authority, and evidence applicability. Preserve child behavior/state authority, existing Function/AR allocations, and earlier contract guarantees. The selected contracts refine prior blanket deferrals; remaining retention, wider collaboration, AR, and realization gaps stay explicit. This is draft design analysis, not implemented or satisfied behavior.

Derive assessor-assisted assurance preparation, explicit retention cooperation and scoped reliance through MOD-007 and IF-014. Preserve actual judgment, command and persistence ownership; target Design only.
